nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are the benefits of using biochar as an end product?
nodes.answer: Biochar can reduce fertilizer need, improve soil health, and enhance crop yield, particularly in areas vulnerable to climate change-induced droughts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sustainable agriculture practices|Eco-friendly fertilizer application_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What type of nitrogen fertilization has shown positive effects on species performance?
nodes.answer: Limited nitrogen fertilization and higher plant rearing temperatures have shown positive effects on the species performance.

nodes.question: Where was the long-term fertilization experiment conducted?
nodes.answer: The experiment was conducted at the Dongyang experimental station in Shanxi Province, China.
